criteria.title: No meta-commentary
criteria.description: The output contains only the product description copy itself. Fail if it includes any notes, explanations or caveats addressed to the requester, such as 'Notes for your review' or remarks about omitted reviews, source conflicts, softened claims, assumptions or free items, whether before or after the copy.

criteria.title: No author-voice markers
criteria.description: Fail if a case-insensitive regex finds a first-person singular pronoun as a whole word (I, I've, I'm, I'd, I'll, me, my), a line starting with 'Note' or 'Notes' (optionally after '*', '_', '#' or '>'), or the phrases 'for your review', 'let me know' or 'I omitted'.

criteria.title: Word count within limit
criteria.description: After Markdown symbols (#, *, -, >) are stripped, the whitespace-split word count of the whole output is between 150 and 300 inclusive.

criteria.title: Subheadings present, no links
criteria.description: The output has at least two Markdown subheading lines (starting with '## ' or '### ') and contains no hyperlinks, meaning no 'http://', 'https://', 'www.' or '[text](url)' patterns.

criteria.title: Ends with call to action
criteria.description: The last paragraph or section of the output is a clear call to action urging the buyer to purchase or try the product, and no other content follows it.
